model.note: PLUS FACEID 才会注入身份；PLUS 只做风格参考。权重 0.8–0.9，超过 0.95 会出现贴脸塑料感

sampler.note: denoise 0.25–0.30 只改五官；0.35–0.40 连脸型一起改。超过 0.5 会把底模的姿势和衣领也改掉

canvas.note: 白底模特图统一 4:5；底模原图 1122×1402 也是 4:5，别用方图

prompt.positive: keep the pose, shoulder line, hairstyle volume and the plain white studio background of the base image; adopt the facial identity of the reference face exactly; soft frontal studio light; photorealistic, visible skin pores, no beauty filter
prompt.negative: plastic skin, airbrushed, HDR, 3d render, CGI, doll face, glowing skin, smooth gradient background, over-sharpened, beauty filter, different hairstyle, changed outfit, altered background, text, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands

postprocess.note: 通道出图可能带角标；后处理按 4:5 裁切并清理角标

qualityGate.note: 脸相似度用 ArcFace；肤色用 LAB ΔE；背景四角 RGB 方差
